Game Overview

At its heart, Neon Maze Protocol is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Neon Maze Protocol keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Neon Maze Protocol?

Neon Maze Protocol is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Neon Maze Protocol free to play?

Yes, Neon Maze Protocol is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
